comparison_policy.raw_source_recovery: Original unaltered PDFs with SHA-256 plus page PNGs are the raw print witness; print has no native Unicode sequence. Raw digital XML is preserved byte-for-byte.
comparison_policy.typing_aid: Perseus strings seeded transcription; each elected heading, label, entry and closing was checked visually against print. Only PDF locators came from extraction.
comparison_policy.glyph_policy: Printed theta type is represented as ϑ (U+03D1), numeral-six glyph as ϛ (U+03DB), superscript numeral stroke as ʹ (U+0374), Greek apostrophe as ᾽ (U+1FBD). No NFC/NFKC rewrite of elected output. Lexical final sigma is retained. Exact type shapes and accent placement remain recoverable in images.
comparison_policy.layout_policy: Unletterspace the spaced heading for readable transcription, join ordinary line-wrap hyphenation, retain one item per printed label. Significant cross-page word in X.6 and continuous editorial bracket group in II are documented. No source words, labels, ordering or punctuation are silently corrected.
comparison_policy.comparison_only: NFC and declared theta/apostrophe/stroke/stigma encodings may be compared equivalently; they never overwrite raw or elected readings. Substantive, accent/breathing, bracket-scope and punctuation differences remain separate.
